title: Scaling Truth: The Confidence Paradox in AI Fact-Checking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (selective accuracy, abstention-friendly accuracy, and certainty rates) on factual claims across four languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi.
Classifying claims into 'Global North' and 'Global South' categories based on content and publisher location, then comparing model accuracy and confidence levels between these regions.
